| [QUESTION-132](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-132.md) v2 | Under what conditions do initially equivalent adaptive operators differentiate into functionally complementary specialists that each have positive recovery growth when rare, rather than into roles kept in place by external load balancing or by persistent authority asymmetries? | The central mathematical question of the synthesis the owner relayed on 2026-10-18. [QUESTION-083](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-083.md) asks whether operators sharing one update rule can come to hold differentiated authority. This asks the coexistence version: does the differentiation produce stabilizing negative frequency dependence, meaning every specialist recovers when rare (Chesson's stabilizing mechanisms, [LIT-1219](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1219.md), unread)? Or is it held in place from outside, or by one process's entrenched advantage? An answer is a population model that derives the interaction structure from learned contributions, states recovery criteria, and finds the regimes of coexistence and exclusion. Heterogeneous embeddings, unequal routing weights or persistent expert identities do not answer it. | Open |
| [QUESTION-135](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-135.md) | When does spectral differentiation among learned features correspond to stabilizing coexistence among the processes that implement them, and what besides the feature geometry decides it? | From the synthesis the owner relayed on 2026-10-18. In symmetric resource-mediated competition the interaction matrix is the Gram matrix of the components' feature vectors, A = UᵀU, so representational redundancy and competitive overlap are one object ([CLAIM-369](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-369.md)). In the two-component case invasion growth equals λ_min(A) ([CASE-118](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-118.md)). But the same A supports coexistence or exclusion depending on the growth rates. An answer says when the Gram spectrum of a learned representation predicts that the processes carrying its features will coexist, and what else, such as supply, task distribution or evaluation opportunities, has to be fixed for it to. | Open |
